name: aging-wip-azure-devops
description: Aging WIP chart for Azure DevOps Boards (hub + dashboard widget)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:public: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file overrides.public.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file overrides.dev.json --output-path out
